required_public_gate: Portable correction checker, source/disposition review and root publication adoption
mathematical_intake_disposition: Fully handled by a reviewed counterexample to its principal universal claim, once root registers the correction. The false theorem is not recovered.

historical_remaining_work_not_silently_a: Identify and read exact theorem targets; assess a replacement derivation and record retained inputs.
historical_admission_evidence.component_acceptance_note: Exact existing packet evidence is bound; this inventory does not independently reaccept every partial proof or establish novelty.

historical_admission_evidence.scope: Specified principal-result contract with its corrections and retained inputs; not a claim that every cited result or conjecture is proved.

current_principal_recovery.scope: Explicit rank-four chiral Sz(32768) polytope of type {31,31,25} refutes the fixed principal statement; journal text, later literature and historical priority are not adjudicated.

proposed_row.next_obligation: Principal source assertion refuted by an accepted explicit example. No attempt to reprove that false assertion or to count it as a compressed true result remains. Retain the public correction and exact source-edition boundary.

ledger_rule.disjointness: Recovered, refuted, pending and editorial ID sets must be pairwise disjoint and exhaust active_original_ids.
ledger_rule.partition: 106 = recovered true/corrected principal contracts + principal refutations + mathematical pending + one editorial; 105 = recovered + refuted + pending.

stop_boundary: All 105 mathematical originals must receive a reviewed final principal disposition. A refuted assertion has a separate terminal status; treating it as an uncompleted recovery would incorrectly demand a proof of a false statement.
historical_records: Keep the old source-reading notes that described the paper as a solution as historical records, explicitly superseded by the new current disposition. Do not silently turn them into current conclusions.
